intro.fr: Bomberman Hero se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Bomberman Hero can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Hudson Soft sort Bomberman Hero en 1998.
text.en: Hudson Soft releases Bomberman Hero in 1998.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, bombhero_v0.1.1.
text.en: The first version, bombhero_v0.1.1, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version bombhero_v0.2.1, la plus récente des 2 versions au nom du jeu sur ce dépôt au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version bombhero_v0.2.1 is released, the latest of the 2 versions named after the game on this repository as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: Bomberman Hero figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Bomberman Hero is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
